data.description:
Implement the ranking core as pure Go with no I/O: budget fit, recency, score, deterministic ordering, pagination with global ranks. Spec: docs/SPEC.md §6.2, §6.3, §6.4, §8 (domain list). Clock is injected; never call time.Now() in this package.

Why: this is the logic the interviewer will probe hardest ("why this formula?"). It must be small, readable and exhaustively tested, and it must not depend on the store (BC-4) so both can land in parallel.

Scope (package internal/domain, building on the types from BC-2):
- Exported constants `BudgetWeight = 0.6`, `RecencyWeight = 0.4`, `RecencyHalfLifeDays = 30`.
- `BudgetFit(price, target float64) float64` asymmetric per §6.2 (under: price/target; over: max(0, 1 - 2*pctOver)).
- `AgeDays(listedDate, now time.Time) int` whole calendar days in UTC, clamped at 0 for future dates.
- `Recency(listedDate, now time.Time) float64` = 0.5^(ageDays/30).
- `Score(budgetFit *float64, recency float64) float64`: with budget 0.6*fit + 0.4*recency; without budget, recency alone.
- `Rank(listings []Listing, in RankInput) []Scored` where `RankInput{TargetBudget *float64; Now time.Time}` and `Scored{Listing; Relevance{Score float64; BudgetFit *float64; Recency float64}}`. Sort per §6.3 on unrounded score desc, then listedDate desc, price asc, source asc, id asc. Use slices.SortStableFunc.
- `Paginate(ranked []Scored, page, pageSize int) (Page, error)` returning `Page{Items []RankedItem; Page, PageSize, TotalItems, TotalPages int}` where RankedItem adds `Rank int` = 1-based index in the whole set. Invalid page (<1) or pageSize (outside 1..100) returns a typed error the handler can map to §5.5 codes; page past end returns an empty Items with correct metadata.
- Full precision kept here; rounding to four decimals is the handler's job (BC-5).
- Tests, table-driven, per §8: worked values from §6.2 (450000/405000/495000/562500/675000; ages 0/30/60/90), asymmetry at equal percentages, future dates, no budget, tied scores with the exact tiebreak order asserted on a crafted fixture, no matches, every pagination boundary including rank continuity across pages (page 2 of pageSize 10 starts at 11), pageSize 1 and 100, zero items giving totalPages 0.

Acceptance:
- `go test -race ./internal/domain/...` green with every §8 domain case present by name.
- Package imports nothing outside the standard library.
- golangci-lint clean.
- A short doc comment at the top of scoring.go states the formula in words; BC-15 will quote it.

Validation: N/A (pure library, no running surface). Record a one-line justification with --role validation and cite the test output.
data.title: Domain: relevance scoring, deterministic ordering, pagination with ranks (pure Go)

data.body: From BC-2 (types frozen at review, branch feat/BC-2-backend-scaffold @ 5da9b80): domain.Listing.ListedDate is time.Time (a calendar date, midnight UTC); the JSON tags on Listing name the wire keys only. Never json.Marshal/Unmarshal Listing, or any struct embedding it (e.g. Scored), directly to or from the wire: time.Time encodes as RFC 3339 and rejects a bare YYYY-MM-DD. Parse and format the date with domain.DateLayout ("2006-01-02") in your own boundary record/DTO structs.

Plan-review triage (art_01M4W2GSCK5ZH6F3NFEK578VKW, PASS, 5 minor): 4 obvious, amended in the plan's Resolutions block (BC-5 seam wording, RankInput.Now zero-value doc, fractional-exponent literal 0.35355339059327373 + keep Score sums on near (arm64 FMA), go.mod header wording). 1 delegator decision: no SPEC §8 edit. BC-5's ticket owns and tests every §5.3 rule in httpapi; BC-3 tests only the domain-resident rules (Paginate page>=1, pageSize 1..100; status enum already in BC-2 TestParseStatus). No complex items, no evolutionary items.

Code review art_01M4W39EHHZZZG7MCVW0ABDC5E PASS @ 8dc03cb, routing: (1) MINOR paginate.go Page.Items doc 'never nil' vs zero Page on error -> FIX (one-line doc qualification via implementer sub-agent, then exact-head re-review). (2) NOTE BudgetFit(0,0)=NaN -> SKIP with justification: outside the documented precondition target > 0 (plan: no guard, no invented behavior); BC-5 rejects targetBudget <= 0 at the boundary per §5.3, and a NaN would still sort deterministically.

Re-review art_01M4W3P2T70J5RP0JX5B8D1EZ0 PASS @ e9144d6 (exact HEAD; the Page.Items doc fix from art_01M4W39EHHZZZG7MCVW0ABDC5E is in). Routing: (1) SPEC §5.4 example 0.8731 vs §6.2 0.7414 -> SKIP here: already assigned to BC-5 (run-state decision log 00:47Z), BC-3 tests use 0.7414213562373095. (2) BudgetFit target<=0 precondition -> FIXED as a lattice comment on BC-5. (3) AgeDays assumes ListedDate is midnight UTC -> cross-ticket reminder comment on BC-4. (4) nit rank_test.go tieFixture local named want -> SKIP: cosmetic, documented by its comment, not worth a review cycle (reviewer concurs).

Exact-head re-review art_01M4W43Z0BHF3F3X0TKWMW9MSK PASS @ ee09340 (after merging master/BC-7; full make check green; validation art_01M4W3XEZH9E0BBPZFWTQFRJR8 @ ee09340). Routing: (1) MINOR scoring.go AgeDays doc says location of either value does not matter (false for a non-UTC listedDate) -> FIX, doc-only, fix cycle 2 of 2 (cap). (2) SPEC §5.4 example 0.8731 -> SKIP here, owned by BC-5 per run-state 00:47Z decision (BC-15/BC-6 consume the corrected value). (3) optional nit: input_order_independent counts visits not distinct orderings -> SKIP, reviewer verified 720 distinct permutations empirically; test sound as written.
Final exact-head review art_01M4W4GP7NV84NM69TY4JRJ6HZ PASS @ cdec405, no issues in diff. Its one note (SPEC §5.4 example 0.8731) -> SKIP here, owned by BC-5 per run-state 00:47Z decision.

BC-3 complete, handed to the Orchestrator at cdec405 (status in_validation). Built: backend/internal/domain/scoring.go (BudgetWeight/RecencyWeight/RecencyHalfLifeDays, BudgetFit, AgeDays, Recency, Score; file header states the formula in words for BC-15), rank.go (RankInput, Relevance, Scored, Rank with a single cmp.Or comparator byRelevance, slices.SortStableFunc), paginate.go (MaxPageSize, ErrPageOutOfRange/ErrPageSizeOutOfRange joined, RankedItem, Page, Paginate with global ranks and overflow-safe past-end handling), plus table-driven tests named after every SPEC §8 domain item (66 PASS). Stdlib only, no time.Now, no BC-2 type changes, no SPEC edits. Deviations: none from SPEC; plan's tie fixture row 5 note corrected in a test comment (score-only key covered by TestRank/with_budget). Findings routed: 2 doc fixes applied (Page.Items non-nil scope, AgeDays midnight-UTC expectation; 2 of 2 fix cycles used), BudgetFit target<=0 precondition and MaxPageSize/sentinels noted on BC-5, midnight-UTC ListedDate reminder on BC-4, SPEC §5.4 example 0.8731 left to BC-5 (decision log 00:47Z), cosmetic test nits skipped. Merged master twice (BC-2 at 7ab182d, BC-7 at 83952b0); full make check green. No follow-up tickets created.
